description: Daniell galvanic cell diagram: two beakers, Zn rod in 1M ZnSO4 (anode, minus) and Cu rod in 1M CuSO4 blue solution (cathode, plus), U-shaped salt bridge between them, voltmeter in external wire, electron flow arrows from Zn to Cu
author: Dubito, ergo quaero

review.shows: A clear diagram of a Daniell galvanic cell featuring two beakers, a Zn anode, a Cu cathode, a U-shaped salt bridge, an external wire with a meter, and electron flow indicators.
